products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and illustration application. The foundation governs the project through a community model and makes the software freely available, with no cloud dependency required for core functionality.

On the AI side, the foundation offers Krita AI, an open-source digital art tool that supports local AI plugins, meaning AI features run on the user's own hardware rather than through cloud services. The project's community governance structure means development priorities and plugin ecosystems are shaped by contributors rather than a commercial entity.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are associated with the Krita Foundation in the available data.
